import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')
ec2 = df[df['resource_kind'].str.contains('EC2', case=False, na=False)]
print(ec2['resource_kind'].unique())
print(ec2['state'].unique())
idle = ec2[(ec2['state']=='running') & (ec2['avg_cpu_pct_14d']<2) & (ec2['max_network_mb_14d']<5)]
print(idle[['resource_id','state','avg_cpu_pct_14d','max_network_mb_14d']])
